summary: Publish and recover one frozen release batch through signed immutable records, reviewed workflow repairs and observed registry receipts.
userImpact: Publication failures can resume the approved candidate without creating another software release or rebuilding its artifacts.
Publication status distinguishes qualified, approved, publishing, partially published and verified published outcomes.

instructions: Install workflow plugin 0.1.16 and the reviewed protected-main publication workflows; use the frozen source and explicit recovery_prs when repairing an already qualified release.

configuration: Explicit release dispatch retains source_ref, release_tag, release_pr and required_prs; optional recovery_prs lists every reviewed publication-only repair after the frozen source.
Signed publication identities and append-only observations are stored in enterpriseglue-oss-release-publication on GHCR.
Release Publication Reconcile automatically observes publisher completion. Manual resume=true renews approval and security acceptance before dispatching only incomplete publishers.
GitHub history reads project merge state, branch names and labels one bounded page at a time; the workflow plugin advances independently to 0.1.16.
Explicit prepare_replacement=true may supersede an unpublished reserved release PR and regenerate one replacement candidate at the same version. Neither tag nor GitHub release may exist.
security: Automatic events remain non-publishing. Frozen batch ancestry, generated-document and managed-comment equality, exact candidate signatures and immutable payload hashes remain mandatory.

Recovery requires explicit first-party repair PRs and a strict path allowlist. Application sources, dependency locks, package manifests, Dockerfiles, charts, migrations, scanner policy and unknown paths cannot qualify as publication-only repairs.
Fresh scans cover all five exact image roles on AMD64 and ARM64 under the pinned scanner and unchanged severity/ignore policy, with current vulnerability database metadata and hashed reports.
Unknown registry state and immutable conflicts stop recovery writes. Scratch canary records are marked as fixtures and cannot enter the production publication repository.
documentation: Technical release/versioning documentation and the artifact-promotion runbook define frozen identity, workflow authority, observation states, retry conditions and recovery commands.
Maintained ship, release and watch skills describe the same protocol and keep deployment approval separate.
Replacement preparation preserves the prior published changelog bytes, removes superseded unpublished sections and keeps metadata-only release PRs separate from the code-PR batch.
knownLimitations: Observed registry publication does not establish Cloud installation, route promotion or production deployment.
A content change requires a new generated document and qualified candidate; only reviewed publication-only repairs may reuse frozen artifacts.
rollback: Revert the reviewed publication tooling and stop new recovery dispatches. Retain signed records and existing releases; never delete or repoint published tags. No package or database rollback is required.
validation: Local qualification passed 181 CI contracts and the aggregate guard, 122 release-note/package regressions, warning-free workspace lint, Actionlint, Shellcheck, package discipline and documentation-boundary checks.

The maintained plugin passed 11 repository contracts and official checks for all 25 skills. The separate official Python plugin-manifest validator is unavailable locally; installer and protected validation remain distinct evidence.

Real Git histories exercise frozen-source recovery, explicit repair ancestry, prohibited content changes and reserved-version replacement. The actual toolchain authority and privileged candidate-validation scripts are executed in regression tests.

The read-only production CLI authorization canary tests automatic-event rejection, incomplete batches, source drift, document mismatch, reviewed publication-only repair and application-drift rejection. Signed scratch registry and protected candidate qualification remain required before publication.
